name: Lillyann ~ One Day I Woke Up at the Normal World.
source:
One day, I was hit by a carriage and... I died.

But why did I wake up in another world and take over the life of this girl named Ann? She was a terrible person, who bullied her classmate.

"I think he hates me and I can't blame him, but I'm not going to regret it because I didn't do the bad things. After a while, he will realize that I am no longer a threat to him and will ignore me."
Or that's what I thought that time. But I was completely wrong.

A cute and heartwarming love story.

[From [url=https://imaginovel.itch.io/lillyann]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天，我被一輛馬車撞了，然後……死了。

可是，為什麼我會在另一個世界醒來，接手一個名叫安的女孩的人生？她是個糟糕的人，曾經欺負自己的同班同學。

「我想他一定很討厭我，這也不能怪他。不過，我不會為那些壞事後悔，因為它們並不是我做的。過一陣子，他就會明白我已經不會再威脅他，然後不再理會我。」
至少，當時我是這麼想的。然而，我完全錯了。

一段可愛又暖心的愛情故事。

[摘自[url=https://imaginovel.itch.io/lillyann]itch.io[/url]]
